title: 24x7 autonomous NEXY branch command prompt
scope: Generate a copy-paste system command for a ChatGPT agent to work only on NEXY.AI in its own exclusive branch, continuously compare against real spec, self-repair, and preserve passed requirements.
inputs_summary: User requested a dedicated AI-only branch, autonomous continuous operation, no mid-task escalation for ordinary bugs, spec-driven coding, and a branch-local do-not-touch notice for other agents.
actions: added exclusive-branch marker and protection strategy
added spec-convergence loop and final gates

claims_proofs.claim: A normal chat cannot literally run 24/7 without a persistent/scheduled execution environment.
claims_proofs.proof: product/runtime limitation; prompt can only mandate continuation while execution is active and durable checkpoints for resumption.

claims_proofs.claim: GitHub branch exclusivity cannot be guaranteed solely by a branch name.
claims_proofs.proof: true enforcement requires branch/ruleset permissions and ideally a distinct bot/service identity.

successes: Produced design for dedicated branch ownership, no-touch notice, continuous spec audit/fix loop, drift handling, and resume checkpoints.
decisions: Use ASCII branch name for compatibility and put Thai exclusivity label in branch-local policy files.
Do not allow the agent to suppress real blockers; it must self-solve ordinary defects but truthfully report authorization/irreversible blockers.
Retain safety gates for destructive production writes, secrets, and history rewrites.
unresolved: Actual branch protection/ruleset feasibility depends on GitHub permissions and actor identity.
Literal 24/7 requires a persistent runner/scheduler or Work/automation environment.
risks: Foreign actors using the same GitHub identity cannot be reliably distinguished by branch protection alone.
Unbounded self-modification could create regressions without strict pass-lock and spec gates.
limits: This task creates a command prompt, not the actual branch or 24/7 runner.
rollback: Delete/deprecate this prompt record if superseded; no target-repository change exists to roll back.
next_actions: Use the generated command in a connected ChatGPT agent with GitHub access.
If true continuous execution is required, attach a persistent scheduler/runner.
note: No target execution was attempted; known limitations are recorded rather than treated as failures.
